claim: All is analysed as determiner because adding it makes the proposals identifiable.
evidence_summary: External all is independently available in all the three proposals and all you who … . Either bracketing can identify the set.
finding: Identifiability cannot alone settle attachment. CGEL’s analogy with all proposals remains structural evidence.
inference: Does making a set identifiable locate all inside the NP as determiner?

evidence.passage: §12, p. 434. All is analysed as determiner because adding it makes the proposals identifiable.
evidence.example: Compare all three proposals with all the three proposals. The second has an independent position for all outside the definite NP. Either proposed structure for the first can pick out the entire identifiable set.
evidence.establishes: Identifiability leaves the first attachment undecided. CGEL’s analogy with all proposals and all the proposals is a separate syntactic consideration.
evidence.locator: Structural analyses with a genuine rival
